# DCore · dcore-qa — QA / Test Runs

Stand-alone entry point for one DCore module. **Purpose:** test plan scaffold from text; --discover generates executable scenarios from a live page; --plan executes a test plan in a real browser; --scenarios executes functional scenarios across browser/API/command/verify steps with per-step evidence (negative/boundary cases: HELD or VIOLATED, violations become defect candidates; --only selects a subset); both write the Detailed Test Report, Detailed Defect Report and Test Case Register (PDF + JSON + Markdown).

User arguments: $ARGUMENTS

## Locate the engine
The engine is the sibling `dcore` skill, installed next to this one: `DCORE = <this skill's base directory>/../dcore`.
Use that absolute path below. If `$DCORE/scripts/dcore.mjs` does not exist, stop and tell the user to reinstall
DCore (`node skills/dcore/scripts/install.mjs --user` from a clone of the repository).

## Run
1. Before the first run, read `$DCORE/modules/dcore-qa.md`: the full contract (inputs, outputs, failure behavior).
2. Build the invocation from the user's arguments and request:
```
node "$DCORE/scripts/dcore.mjs" dcore-qa "<feature or spec>"   (test plan scaffold)
node "$DCORE/scripts/dcore.mjs" dcore-qa --discover <url> --plan-out plan.json
node "$DCORE/scripts/dcore.mjs" dcore-qa --plan plan.json --out .dcore/evidence/<run>
node "$DCORE/scripts/dcore.mjs" dcore-qa --scenarios <file.json> [--only negative]
```
   Add `--json` when you need the structured result, `--report <dir>` for the evidence report.
3. Report from the evidence only: per check PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / SKIPPED / NOT_TESTED / NOT_APPLICABLE, the exact
   commands run, screenshots, and limitations. Never report PASS for something that was not executed.

If the task needs more than this module (for example test, then fix, then verify), switch to `/dcore` with the task in
plain English; it plans the whole workflow.
